decisive_items: 1.9 cm × 2.8 cm contrast-enhancing mass in bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy
isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
response.rationale: The bladder wall mass with elevated normetanephrine and normal adrenals localizes the catecholamine-secreting tumor to an extra-adrenal paraganglioma, not pheochromocytoma.

rejected.why: Normal adrenal glands on CT contradict adrenal pheochromocytoma; the mass is in the bladder wall.
